name: WGU Master's degree in Computer Science

mentions.name: WGU Master's degree in Computer Science
mentions.description: A competency-based master's degree in computer science from Western Governors University that the author registered for while unemployed, using it to fill time between job interviews. WGU's per-term, competency-based format let an experienced software engineer complete the work extremely quickly and finally put an MS credential after their name.
mentions.problem: Having only so much TV and YouTube to watch while unemployed between interviews, and wanting a productive way to kill large amounts of time while getting something out of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since WGU just started doing masters degrees in CS, I decided it would be a way to kill large amounts of time while getting at least a little out of it, so I registered for it.
